fields.account: Kingston piloted Beam Magic Notes to transcribe and summarize adult-social-care conversations, assessments, and supervision. The council reports 50–60% less time completing notes and assessments, and supervision write-ups falling from 40 minutes to under 10 minutes. The source reports limitations for people with low verbal skills or mental capacity and with poor audio quality.
